class.name: FellowTraversalPose3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a character's pose while its [FellowTraversal3D] mantles or vaults — procedural (two-bone IK for the hands and feet, the hips lowered, the torso leaned) or the clip set for the kind.
class.description: A modifier of the character's [Skeleton3D] (after the animation's: an [AnimationTree] or [AnimationPlayer] plays under it). It finds its [FellowTraversal3D] among the children of the skeleton's ancestors (or at [member traversal_path]) and, while a mantle moves the body, poses the bones over whatever the animation plays: the torso tipped towards the wall (the spine and chest), the hips lowered as far as the traversal allows until the shoulders are within the arms' reach of the edge (hanging, pushing up), the hands on the edge (two-bone IK, the elbows out and down), the feet against the wall's face and stepping onto the top, or tucked over a vault (two-bone IK, the knees towards the wall, the feet keeping their turn in the world). When the traversal has a clip for the kind, the clip is played across the mantle instead, its root bone's motion since the clip's start taken out. Blended in and out over [member blend_time]. The bones are found by their names in common rigs: Godot's humanoid profile ([code]Hips[/code], [code]Spine[/code], [code]Chest[/code], [code]LeftUpperArm[/code], [code]LeftLowerArm[/code], [code]LeftHand[/code], [code]LeftUpperLeg[/code], [code]LeftLowerLeg[/code], [code]LeftFoot[/code] and the right side's), Mixamo's ([code]mixamorig:LeftArm[/code], [code]LeftForeArm[/code], [code]LeftUpLeg[/code], [code]LeftLeg[/code]…), Unreal's mannequin ([code]pelvis[/code], [code]spine_01[/code], [code]upperarm_l[/code], [code]lowerarm_l[/code], [code]hand_l[/code], [code]thigh_l[/code], [code]calf_l[/code], [code]foot_l[/code]…) and Blender's ([code]upper_arm.L[/code], [code]forearm.L[/code], [code]thigh.L[/code], [code]shin.L[/code]…); [member bone_names] names others. See [code]docs/decisions/0180-traversal-mantling.md[/code].

members.member: The seconds the pose takes to blend in when a mantle starts and out when it ends (a clip's last pose is held while it fades).

Bones named for roles, over the names found by themselves: a role's name ([code]"hips"[/code], [code]"spine"[/code], [code]"chest"[/code], [code]"left_upper_arm"[/code], [code]"left_lower_arm"[/code], [code]"left_hand"[/code], [code]"right_upper_arm"[/code], …, [code]"left_upper_leg"[/code], [code]"left_lower_leg"[/code], [code]"left_foot"[/code], [code]"right_upper_leg"[/code], …) to the bone's name.
The feet placed on the wall's face and the top.
The hands placed on the edge (and the hips lowered for them to reach it).
The torso tipped towards the wall.
The [FellowTraversal3D] followed; by default the first found among the children of the skeleton's ancestors.
